summary: Theiarco app with Pioneers, Tasks, and Notes pages. Adding Export to PDF functionality to all three pages using jsPDF or similar library, with branded headers (app name, report title, date) using primary color #43587A.
architectural_notes: Primary brand color: #43587A (used for PDF headers/accents)
PDF files named: pioneers-report.pdf, tasks-report.pdf, notes-report.pdf
PDF header includes: app name 'Theiarco', report title, and current date

existing_features.title: Update the existing `frontend/src/utils/pioneersPdfExport.ts` utility to generate a downloadable PDF file (downloaded as 'pioneers-report.pdf') instead of opening a print window. The PDF must include: a header with 'Theiarco' app name, 'Pioneers Report' title, and the current date; a professional table with columns for Name, Service Year, Total Hours, Average Hours, Current Status, and Monthly Hours; header/accent colors using #43587A; black text on white background; landscape orientation for the wide table.

Update the existing `frontend/src/utils/tasksPdfExport.ts` utility to generate a downloadable PDF file (downloaded as 'tasks-report.pdf') instead of opening a print window. The PDF must include: a header with 'Theiarco' app name, 'Tasks Report' title, and the current date; a professional table with columns for Title, Due Date, Category, Status, and Notes; header/accent colors using #43587A; black text on white background; completed tasks shown with strikethrough styling.

Update the existing `frontend/src/utils/notesPdfExport.ts` utility to generate a downloadable PDF file (downloaded as 'notes-report.pdf') instead of opening a print window. The PDF must include: a header with 'Theiarco' app name, 'Notes Report' title, and the current date; notes organized by category with category headers styled in #43587A; each note showing its title, content, and creation date; black text on white background.

new_feature_requests.summary: Export to PDF buttons on Pioneers, Tasks, and Notes pages generating formatted downloadable PDFs with Theiarco branding, #43587A accents, and print-friendly layout

On the existing `frontend/src/pages/Pioneers.tsx` page, ensure there is an 'Export to PDF' button positioned in the top-right action area next to the existing 'Export to CSV' and 'Add Pioneer' buttons. The button must call the updated `exportPioneersToPdf` utility passing the currently loaded pioneer data. Style the button to visually match the existing export buttons on the page. Do not alter any other part of the Pioneers page.

On the existing `frontend/src/pages/Tasks.tsx` page, ensure there is an 'Export to PDF' button positioned in the top-right action area next to the existing 'Export to CSV' and 'Add Task' buttons. The button must call the updated `exportTasksToPdf` utility passing the currently loaded task data. Style the button to visually match the existing export buttons on the page. Do not alter any other part of the Tasks page.

On the existing `frontend/src/pages/Notes.tsx` page, ensure there is an 'Export to PDF' button positioned in the top-right action area next to the existing 'Add Note' button. The button must call the updated `exportNotesToPdf` utility passing the currently loaded notes data. Style the button to visually match the existing buttons on the page. Do not alter any other part of the Notes page.

Implement the actual file download mechanism in the three PDF export utilities (`pioneersPdfExport.ts`, `tasksPdfExport.ts`, `notesPdfExport.ts`). Use the browser's print-to-PDF approach via a hidden iframe or a new window with `window.print()`, OR use a client-side PDF library (such as jsPDF with jsPDF-AutoTable) to programmatically generate a Blob and trigger a browser download via a temporary anchor element (`<a download='filename.pdf'>`). The chosen approach must result in the file being saved with the correct filename without requiring the user to manually rename it from a print dialog.
